Original worker notes: ROOT CAUSE FIX: --build-baseline idempotency bug. In scan(), the `allowed` set was always populated from existing baseline regardless of mode. Running check mode after would then detect 6 unallowlisted hits → exit 1. FIX: `allowed` is now mode-conditional — build-baseline uses empty Set (collects ALL current matches), check mode uses existing allowlist. VE
